definition: PhD Research Lab is an agent-native scientific research environment that provides persistent knowledge, memory, computation, experimentation, collaboration, and verifiable evidence infrastructure, while allowing advanced AI agents to autonomously develop and execute their own research strategies.
scope: Declared bounded computational research domains until broader domain validation is actually available
first_action: Audit and remove unnecessary backend interference with agent reasoning; do not add another Research Engine

learning.principle: Don't build an AI Scientist. Build an environment where an AI Scientist can learn to become more capable.
learning.level: environment, not a prescribed domain research workflow
learning.main_environment_promotion: propose only after same-suite verification and applicable authorization

criteria.criterion: One paper project, explicit research question, scoped permissions and budget
Natural model-led questions and follow-ups without unintended workflow launch
Traceable prior art, contradictory evidence and limited novelty claims
Method commitments mapped to mathematical definitions, actual code and falsifiable tests
Actual controls, baselines, uncertainty analysis and fresh replay appropriate to the investigation
Agent may reject or revise hypotheses, methodology and research strategy from observations
Precise context and commitments survive long work and restart without project leakage
Independent checks, claim-evidence consistency and correct inconclusive outcomes
Versioned procedural lessons with evidence, held-out evaluation, review and rollback
Actual supported native/API/local inference, isolation, cancellation and usage provenance
Recoverable one-paper-project migration preserving multiple code experiments
Evidence-linked report/paper, negative results, faithful tables/figures/citations and limitations
Frozen same-suite guided/open-ended evaluation with all attempts and human interventions recorded
Ordinary coordination, research-direction choice, rejection and continuation do not need routine human scientific rescue

future_agent_rules: Read RESEARCH_QUALITY_OBJECTIVES.md before architecture or core changes.
Update STATE/PLAN with criterion IDs, measured scope, evidence and unknowns.
Keep model scientific decisions separate from enforced security, resource and evidence constraints.
Never claim L3/L4 from role names, software coverage, model self-reports or one polished paper.
Never build separate L2/L3/L4 workflow engines; use one environment with scoped autonomy policy.
Retire obsolete provider-specific tests only with a functional replacement record.
